lead: Maneka Gandhi is best known as an Indian politician, born on 26 August 1956 in New Delhi.
As of 2026, she is 70 years old, and her birth date places her under the Virgo sign.
She has held the office of Member of the 16th Lok Sabha and Member of the 11th Lok Sabha.
This profile collects the Maneka facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.

sections.heading: Maneka Gandhi — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Maneka Gandhi was born on 26 August 1956 in New Delhi, and holds Indian nationality.
She received her education at The Lawrence School, Sanawar, Lady Shri Ram College for Women, Jawaharlal Nehru University and University of Delhi.
She is recorded as speaking English.

sections.heading: Maneka Gandhi — Career and Professional Work
paras: Maneka Gandhi works primarily as a politician, journalist, animal rights advocate, ecologist and environmentalist.

She has held the following offices: Member of the 16th Lok Sabha, Member of the 11th Lok Sabha, Member of the 12th Lok Sabha, Member of the 13th Lok Sabha, Member of the 15th Lok Sabha and Member of the 17th Lok Sabha. She is affiliated with Bharatiya Janata Party.

sections.heading: Maneka Gandhi — Family, Marriage and Personal Life
paras: She is married to Sanjay Gandhi.
She is a parent to Varun Gandhi.
